U.S. TIGHTENS ROBOT IMPORT RULES

The FCC will restrict imports of certain foreign-made advanced robots, including humanoids, quadrupeds and some autonomous devices.

Morgan Stanley expects limited near-term impact on Chinese humanoid robot makers, as existing FCC-approved products remain exempt and U.S. sales are minimal. However, new product restrictions could weigh on Chinese robot vacuum and autonomous mobile robot makers with larger U.S. exposure.
